title: Employee Actions — Create / Edit
overviewHtml:
A personnel action for the employee — a promotion, transfer, re-grading or separation — with its reason and date.

Personnel actions can be routed for approval; HR raises them, not the employee. The same kind of action cannot be recorded twice on the same day for the same employee.

fields.label: StartDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. No two records for the same employee and personal action can start on the same date.
fields.html: What it is. The first day this record applies.

fields.label: PersonalAction
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Personal Action master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The kind of action.

Example. Promotion
fields.adminHtml: Maintained under General Master Info → Personal Actions. Their requirement flags are not enforced here at present.

fields.label: ActionReason
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Personal Action Reason master data.
fields.html:
What it is. Why the action is being taken.

Example. Annual performance review
fields.adminHtml: Maintained under General Master Info → Personal Action Reasons.

fields.label: RecommendedBy
fields.html:
What it is. Who recommended the action, as free text.

Example. Department Head, Finance

fields.label: Comments
fields.html: What it is. Free-text notes about this record.
